hero.titleThin: Continuous identity verification that runs entirely in your browser.
hero.subtitle: A remote senior dev costs <highlight>$30,000</highlight> in risk if they fake the interview with AI. Deep-Check validates identity continuously -- not just at login. Six independent detection layers. Zero biometric data leaves the device.
hero.ctaNote: No credit card. No signup. Runs in your browser.

howItWorks.heading:
Four layers between your
organization and fraud
howItWorks.subhead: Deep-Check does not verify once and forget. It watches the entire session, fusing six independent signals in real-time.
howItWorks.step01Desc: The candidate shows their face. MediaPipe extracts 478 landmarks. No image is stored -- only a local embedding used for session matching.
howItWorks.step02Desc: Six layers run simultaneously: rPPG heartbeat, FACS micro-expressions, EfficientNet-B4 pixel analysis, CNN blendshape classifier, blink physics, and lighting reflex detection.
howItWorks.step03Desc: Keystroke dynamics capture flight time, hold time, and typing rhythm. Code velocity analysis flags AI-generated copy-paste patterns in real-time.
howItWorks.step04Desc: All signals fuse through a Bayesian ensemble in logit-space. The trust score updates every second. Anomalies trigger instant alerts to the hiring manager.

detectionStack.heading: Built to be unfakeable
detectionStack.subhead: Not one model. Not one check. Six independent layers that would each need to be defeated simultaneously.
detectionStack.rppgDesc: Extracts blood volume pulse from facial video. Real skin shows cardiac rhythm; deepfakes and static images produce flat or synthetic signals. Weighted at 0.30 in the Veritas ensemble.
detectionStack.keystrokeDesc: Flight time, hold time, and rhythm patterns are as unique as a fingerprint. Impossible to replicate in real-time.
detectionStack.facsDesc: Action Unit analysis detects involuntary facial movements that deepfake renderers cannot reproduce at the correct temporal frequency.
detectionStack.efficientNetDesc: 18.6M parameter model with multi-scale Laplacian frequency branch. Trained on 155K images across 7 datasets. AUC 0.9999, EER 0.31%. Anti-leak verified with hash deduplication and zero train/test overlap.
detectionStack.cnnDesc: Separate classifier operating on blendshape coefficients extracted from the face mesh. Catches swap artifacts invisible to pixel-level analysis.
detectionStack.codeDesc: Detects LLM-generated code by measuring perplexity scores, typing cadence, and paste-vs-compose velocity anomalies during live coding interviews.
detectionStack.sessionDesc: Continuous re-verification ensures the person who started the session is the same person throughout. Face-swap mid-session triggers instant alerts.

comparison.heading: Deep-Check vs Onfido
comparison.subhead: Onfido verifies who someone is once, at login. Deep-Check verifies who someone is continuously, during the entire session.

docForensics.heading: Document Forensics
docForensics.desc: Detect manipulated images, deepfakes in documents, and falsified metadata in grant applications, dossiers, and document verification workflows.
docForensics.elaDesc: Detects edited regions by comparing JPEG compression artifact levels across the image
docForensics.exifDesc: Identifies editing software signatures (Photoshop, GIMP, Canva) embedded in file metadata
docForensics.aiDesc: Distinguishes real photographs from AI-generated images across Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion
